snippet.title: Alexey's Winter: Night Adventure
snippet.description:
Get FULL GAME here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1558730?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=nn4AUfNpWQU 

Ukraine themed Point-and-Click hand drawn adventure: the action takes place on a winter night in Ukraine in the nineties. You play as a young man who is faced with an unexpected series of events. Interact with characters. Explore a pencil-drawn world filled with satire and a drop of sadness.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Immerse in an atmospheric setting:a frosty, Ukraine around 1990s on a cold winter's night, setting the stage for an unforgettable adventure.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Experience classic point-and-click gameplay: Intuitive controls, inventory management, and engage in dialogue with characters.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Uncover captivating stories: Embark on an array of quests, each with its own unique charm, where interactions with eccentric characters blend light-hearted humor and poignant moments.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Delight in hand-drawn graphics: hand-crafted with pencil strokes, offering a truly distinctive experience.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Indie passion project: Both programming and art are created by one person.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Choose your language: Enjoy the game in English, Ukrainian, or Russian, immersing yourself fully in the narrative.
